_doc: Phase 5a slice 2 (README.md "Phase 5: the vehicle skeleton"): the vehicle on the byte-memory back end, with AP_Param, GCS_MAVLink and AP_Mission as ardupilot/gcs/GCS.json translates them (its keys, entries and boundary), plus the vehicle from AP_Vehicle::setup and AP_Vehicle::loop. `vehicle` turns on the back end's vehicle features (definitions found on demand, records by value, <cmath>, function pointers, dispatch over the member objects of `copter`, the estimator bridge, stubs for rejected functions). Removed from GCS.json's lists because the vehicle now translates them: the vehicle answers (`answer`: set_mode, arm/disarm, takeoff), AP_Mission's execution state machine and ModeAuto/Copter::set_mode in `unreached`, AP_Mission's callbacks in `skip_members`.
_constants_doc: is_equal<float, float> (AP_Math.cpp:24-38): `std::is_same<double, common_type_nonconst>::value` with common_type_nonconst = float, a constant clang folds without printing its value; constrain_value<int/unsigned/...> (AP_Math.cpp:315): `std::is_floating_point<T>::value`, false for every instance (no floating instance: floats use constrain_value_line); RC_Channel::RC_CALIB_MIN/MAX_LIMIT_PWM (RC_Channel.h:481,483): 1300, 1700; Parameters::k_format_version (Parameters.h:32): 120; RC_Channel::RC_MIN/MAX_LIMIT_PWM (RC_Channel.h:476,478): 800, 2200; (Phase 5d) GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:868-888's namespace-scope constexpr MAVLINK_SET_POS_TYPE_MASK_POS/VEL/ACC/YAW/YAW_RATE_IGNORE and FORCE_SET, the ORs of MAVLink's POSITION_TARGET_TYPEMASK values (common.h: X 1, Y 2, Z 4, VX 8, VY 16, VZ 32, AX 64, AY 128, AZ 256, FORCE_SET 512, YAW 1024, YAW_RATE 2048): 7, 56, 448, 1024, 2048, 512
_drop_doc: reached only under `if (default_file)`, whose value is the HAL's get_custom_defaults_file(): null on the reference board (HAL_PARAM_DEFAULTS_PATH nullptr, AP_HAL/board/sitl.h:50; lockstep.cpp's Util does not override it) (Phase 5b: AP_Param::save, the save queue ObjectBuffer_TS<param_save>, flush and save_io_handler are translated)
_dynamic_doc: vehicle classes with one dynamic class in this vehicle: AP_Vehicle is Copter; RC_Channels/RC_Channel are the Copter ones; the motors are AP_MotorsMatrix (allocate_motors for the quad frame); the attitude controller AC_AttitudeControl_Multi; arming AP_Arming_Copter
_by_address_doc: a virtual call through `Mode *`/`Mode &` dispatches on the object's address over the member objects of `copter` whose class derives from Mode (clang's layout of Copter), each arm the final overrider of that object's class
_bridge_doc: the estimator (stays in the value World ardupilot/out/Estimator/Estimator_lib.lean, reached through the bridge): every member function of these classes and these accessors is a boundary call that records its name (PMem.bridge) and gives the type's default; ardupilot/vehicle/bridge_calls.txt lists them (the API the bridge provides)
_bridge_module_doc: Phase 5a slice 1 (README.md "Phase 5: the estimator bridge"): the memory with the estimator World inside (memory_module ParamMemoryV, generated by support/gen_param_memory_v.py from ParamMemory.lean; GCSMemoryV, VehicleMemoryV import it); every estimator call is a call of its adapter in bridge_module (ardupilot/out/Vehicle/VehicleBridge.lean, generated by ardupilot/vehicle/gen_bridge.py from Vehicle_lib.bridge.json and the estimator's signatures); bridge_inputs: the vehicle functions whose results are World boundary inputs of an adapter (AP_Vehicle::get_time_flying_ms for AP_DAL's time flying in AP_AHRS::update), passed as actions; Phase 5b: an input named pre_* is a translated member function of the estimator class run on the call's object (`this`) before the World call, for a call the World's translation drops (AP_GPS::init's convert_parameters: --drop AP_GPS::convert_parameters in ardupilot/translate_estimator.sh; on the memory it is AP_Param's conversion and flush, whose delay consumes input lines); Phase 5c: an object `{k}` is the call's k-th argument (AP_AHRS::send_ekf_status_report's `GCS_MAVLINK &link`: the translated GCS_MAVLINK::get_chan on it is the World's boundary input `link.get_chan()`)
_static_construction_doc: Phase 5a slice 2: `static_construction` translates the C++ static construction (staticConstruct: the dynamic initializers of the statics the translation uses, in the order of copter_ref's __init_offsets (`init_order`, ardupilot/vehicle/init_order.json) and of each unit's global constructor; member objects' default constructors translated; estimator classes constructed by the World; FUNCTOR_BIND_MEMBER bound). `hal_hook`: every HAL member outside `boundary` is `PMem.hal name this #[args]`, lockstep.cpp's semantics implemented by the replay driver (lean/VehicleReplay.lean).

static_refs._doc: (static construction) a static member named through a derived class: function:name:type -> the static

_zero_statics_doc: (vehicle) `hal` is a reference to the HAL object: here a zeroed object of the HAL's size (clang: 224 bytes), so every driver pointer (`hal.scheduler`, `hal.util`, ...) is null; the drivers' virtual members are `PMem.hal` calls, their data members (`hal.util->persistent_data`) are in the null page below the image.

world_outputs._doc: Phase 5b: the estimator World's output events (cpp2lean.py --output-log --param-save-log, ardupilot/translate_estimator.sh), replayed on the memory after each bridge call as the calls the World's translation made events of: [function, arguments]; {k} the event's k-th field, @f the translated accessor f's result. AP_Param::save on the parameter's address in this image (its C++ path from the World object, PMem.Bridge.addrOfPath, generated from estimator_params.json); GCS_SEND_MESSAGE in AP_AHRS (AP_AHRS.cpp:479, 1777-1778); AP::mission().write_home_to_storage() (AP_AHRS.cpp:1787); AP_Param::notify (set_and_notify in the World: the barometer's ground pressure every 10 s, the compass's external flag); (Phase 5c) GCS_SEND_TEXT in World code (cpp2lean.py --text-log): the vehicle's translated GCS::send_text with the format and the variadic arguments in memory as the C++ caller has them (`%text`: worldOutputs'textBlock), so the text is formatted by the translated print_vprintf
world_outputs._doc_send_text_snprintf: Phase 5c (cpp2lean.py --text-buffers): `char buffer[n]` filled by `hal.util->snprintf(buffer, n, g, ...)` and sent as `GCS_SEND_TEXT(sev, "%s", buffer)` (AP_GPS_Backend::broadcast_gps_type, GPS_Backend.cpp:129-154): `%snprintf {f} {n} {g} {a}` formats into a buffer of n bytes of the drain's frame with the translated AP_HAL::Util::snprintf on hal.util and passes the format f and the variadic block of the buffer's address
world_outputs._doc_text_sink: Phase 5d (cpp2lean.py --text-buffers): `Output.text_sink buf text`, pushed by the bridge's adapter of a World function with a `char *buf` parameter (AP_AHRS::pre_arm_check's failure_msg) after the call: the text the World wrote (`Estimator_lib.CText`: the format and tagged arguments of the last `hal.util->snprintf`/`dal.snprintf` into it, a format that is itself a text formatted first) formatted into the caller's buffer at address buf with the translated AP_HAL::Util::snprintf (C truncation at the call's size); nothing written if the World wrote nothing. `%ctext {f} {t}` (send_text_snprintf, since Phase 5d): the buffer a World text fills, formatted the same way into a buffer of the drain's frame
world_outputs._doc_5c: Phase 5c: the MAVLink sends of the estimator classes' own senders (cpp2lean.py --output-fn: AP_AHRS::send_ekf_status_report, AP_AHRS.cpp:1709; AP_GPS::send_mavlink_gps_raw, AP_GPS.cpp:1405; send_mavlink_gps2_raw, :1446), replayed as the calls of the translated MAVLink library on the link's channel; `&{k}`: the event's k-th field is the record the World's call points to, stored at clang's layout in a temporary of the drain's frame
world_outputs._doc_est_mark: Phase 5c: the World's lock-step points (reference/hal/est_scheduler.cpp est_mark, cpp2lean.py --output-fn): the driver (lean/VehicleReplay.lean) runs the vehicle's part of lockstep.cpp's step and delay there (kind 1: the vehicle's timer processes, the failsafe, the IO processes of the line; kind 2: the delay callback)
world_outputs._doc_console_printf: Phase 5c: the World's console texts (DEV_PRINTF, hal.console->printf: "Init Gyro", "*", "\n" of AP_InertialSensor::_init_gyro; cpp2lean.py --text-log), passed to the HAL's console printf (lean/VehicleReplay.lean: SERIAL0, as lockstep.cpp's console)

_bridge_field_reads_doc: Phase 5b: estimator data members that translated code reads directly (AC_AttitudeControl::reset_yaw_target_and_rate, AC_Circle, AC_Loiter, AC_PosControl read `_ahrs.yaw`): read through a generated adapter from the World object (ardupilot/vehicle/gen_bridge.py); before, the read was of the object's memory address (0x200, the view's stand-in address: 0); Phase 5c: AP_AHRS::yaw_sensor (GCS_MAVLINK::send_global_position_int's hdg, GCS_Common.cpp)
_content_senders_doc: Phase 5c: the 64 content senders of GCS.json's PMem.bframe list are translated (removed from `boundary`): GCS_MAVLINK's and GCS_MAVLINK_Copter's senders on the memory, their estimator getters through the bridge (the World's translation, ardupilot/estimator.use); the estimator classes' own senders (AP_AHRS::send_ekf_status_report, AP_GPS::send_mavlink_gps_raw/gps2_raw) translated in the World, whose mavlink_msg_*_send calls are Output events (cpp2lean.py --output-fn) replayed here on the translated MAVLink library (`world_outputs`). Phase 5b had kept them recorded (README.md "Phase 5b summary", item 3)
_formatter_doc: Phase 5c (D10): ArduPilot's text formatter translated: AP_HAL::Util::snprintf and vsnprintf (Util.cpp, with its BufferPrinter; `hal_translated`: hal.util is the null object of this HAL and neither member reads Util state), print_vprintf (utility/print_vprintf.cpp, its gotos by cpp2lean's GotoRewriter: `goto_rewrite`), ftoa_engine (utility/ftoa_engine.cpp) and ultoa_invert/ulltoa_invert (utility/utoa_invert.cpp); print_vprintf's virtual `s->write(c)` on its AP_HAL::BetterStream is BufferPrinter's (`hal_dispatch`: the only BetterStream print_vprintf is given in translated code). `varargs`: C varargs as on the target (arm64 Apple: `va_list` is `char *`, each variadic argument in its own 8-byte slot): a variadic function takes the address of its caller's block of slots as a hidden last parameter; va_start/va_arg/va_copy/va_end over it. GCS::send_text, GCS_MAVLINK::send_text and GCS::service_statustext are translated (were boundary: no-ops and the recorded STATUSTEXT frames).
_bridge_pointer_results_doc: Phase 5c: estimator functions returning `const T *` into the World (GCS_MAVLINK::send_ahrs2's AP_AHRS::get_secondary_estimates, AP_AHRS.h:202): the adapter (ardupilot/vehicle/gen_bridge.py) copies the pointed-to record, at clang's layout, into a temporary of the caller's frame and returns its address (null for the World's null pointer)
_packed_records_doc: Phase 5c: clang's record layout dump gives the MAVLink message structs (MAVPACKED: the packed attribute after the closing brace of a typedef'd struct) their unpacked layout (time_usec of GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN at 16, sizeof 24), while the compiled code has them packed (offsetof 12, sizeof 20): the records whose names match are laid out packed (cpp2lean_mem.py repack_layout); mavlink_message_t (`__mavlink_message`, a bit-field) keeps the dump's layout (its bytes are only read and written through its members)
_uart_begin_doc: Phase 5c: AP_HAL::UARTDriver::begin is the HAL's (lean/VehicleReplay.lean): on SERIAL3, the GPS's port, the baud rate is that of the World's port stand-in (reference/hal/est_uart.h, EstUART::begin), the same unconnected port of lockstep.cpp that AP_GPS then reads (get_baud_rate: the first probe baud, "GPS 1: probing for SITL at 230400 baud"); before, a no-operation (GCS.json)
_ctor_from_class_doc: Phase 5c: static construction calls a class's user-provided default constructor also when it is defined inline in the class and never called by name (AP_CANManager's CANIface_Params/CANDriver_Params elements: their setup_object_defaults gave CAN_D1_PROTOCOL/CAN_D2_PROTOCOL 0 instead of 1). AP_SerialManager::UARTState::baudrate is translated (GCS.json's boundary answered 115200: SERIAL3, the GPS's port, begins at SERIAL3_BAUD's 230400 in the reference)
_string_pool_doc: (Phase 5d) the C string literals at the reference binary's layout (cpp2lean_mem.py `macho_section`): the linker's merged __TEXT,__cstring section of build/reference/copter_ref is placed whole as constant data and each literal of the code takes its address there, so a read past a literal's end reads the reference's neighbor bytes, as compiled code does: GCS_MAVLINK_Copter::send_available_mode passes mode names of 4 to 17 bytes to mavlink_msg_available_modes_send, which copies 50 (the QGroundControl session's AVAILABLE_MODES). Phase 5d also translates the GUIDED handlers the scenario suite reaches (SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED/GLOBAL_INT and SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET were boundary no-ops; DO_REPOSITION, CONDITION_YAW, DO_CHANGE_SPEED were `unreached`) and the command handlers a ground station sends commonly (SET_MODE, GET_HOME_POSITION, REQUEST_AUTOPILOT_CAPABILITIES, PAUSE_CONTINUE, DO_SET_ROI(_LOCATION), DO_SET_MISSION_CURRENT, RUN_PREARM_CHECKS)
